segment.source:
::You see a group of battered men. Dirty and thin as rails, they appear as if you've just dug them out of a grave. They silently stand there, staring at a $(#man/woman) piloting a Dreadnought with utter disbelief. A few rub their eyes as though wondering whether or not they're hallucinating again, but with every passing second, this metallic beast standing before them seems more and more real.
Finally, one man speaks with a fragile, dry voice.::<end>
segment.target:

They silently stand there, staring at a $(#man/woman) piloting a Dreadnought with utter disbelief. Finally, one man speaks with a fragile, dry voice.::<end>

segment.source:
::You see a group of battered men. Dirty and thin as rails, they appear as if you've just dug them out of a grave. They silently stand there, staring at a $(#man/woman) piloting a Dreadnought with utter disbelief. A few rub their eyes as though wondering whether or not they're hallucinating again, but with every passing second, this metallic beast standing before them seems more and more real.
Finally, one man speaks with a fragile, dry voice.::<end>
You... You found our Dreadnought... You are here... to rescue us... Rescue has arrived! ::The men cheer.::<end>
segment.target: You... You found our Dreadnought... You are here... to rescue us... Rescue has arrived! ::The men cheer.::<end>

segment.source: You... You found our Dreadnought... You are here... to rescue us... Rescue has arrived! ::The men cheer.::<end>
I'm Corporal $(context.player.Name), and yes, I'm here to get you out of this hell hole.<end>
segment.target: I'm Corporal $(context.player.Name), and yes, I'm here to get you out of this hell hole.<end>

segment.source: I'm Corporal $(context.player.Name), and yes, I'm here to get you out of this hell hole.<end>

I'm Private Brady Homan, $(#sir/ma'am)... ::He salutes you slowly and with great effort.:: and you... you're... magnificent! Ahhh, magnificent... We've been stuck here for... for... for a month, I don't even know... We were cornered by those filthy bugs. They swarmed us when the earthquake rocked this place... $(#sir/ma'am)...<end>
segment.target: I'm Private Brady Homan, $(#sir/ma'am)... ::He salutes you slowly and with great effort.:: and you... you're... magnificent! Ahhh, magnificent... We've been stuck here for... for... for a month, I don't even know... We were cornered by those filthy bugs. They swarmed us when the earthquake rocked this place... $(#sir/ma'am)...<end>

segment.source: I'm Private Brady Homan, $(#sir/ma'am)... ::He salutes you slowly and with great effort.:: and you... you're... magnificent! Ahhh, magnificent... We've been stuck here for... for... for a month, I don't even know... We were cornered by those filthy bugs. They swarmed us when the earthquake rocked this place... $(#sir/ma'am)...<end>

We are out of food, drinking water... almost out of ammo. ::He drifts off for a moment, but recomposes himself and continues.:: But now you're here, $(#sir/ma'am)! Thank you... THANK YOU!
Are the burrowers... gone... $(#sir/ma'am)?<end>
segment.target:

We are out of food, drinking water... almost out of ammo. ::He drifts off for a moment, but recomposes himself and continues.:: But now you're here, $(#sir/ma'am)! Thank you... THANK YOU!
Are the burrowers... gone... $(#sir/ma'am)?<end>
<end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: <end>
The coast is clear. Time to go home, soldiers.<end>
segment.target: The coast is clear. Time to go home, soldiers.<end>

segment.source: The coast is clear. Time to go home, soldiers.<end>

::The men, who have dried up so much that they look as if they'd turn to dust by merely moving, now pick up their things in such a lively fashion that it makes you feel nothing short of amazement. Their freedom, now so close and so tasty, appears to have unleashed the last reserves of energy they've saved up only for this particular moment. They all nod at you as a thank you, some smiling, some even crying, as they hurriedly flee their prison.::<end>
segment.target: ::The men, who have dried up so much that they look as if they'd turn to dust by merely moving, now pick up their things in such a lively fashion that it makes you feel nothing short of amazement. They all nod at you as a thank you, some smiling, some even crying, as they hurriedly flee their prison.::<end>
::Wait for them to leave.::<end>
segment.target: ::Wait for them to leave.::<end>

segment.source: ::Wait for them to leave.::<end>
Are you the only ones left alive?<end>
segment.target: Are you the only ones left alive?<end>

segment.source: Are you the only ones left alive?<end>
Yes, $(#sir/ma'am), I'm afraid so. Some were killed by the falling... falling rocks... some killed by the bugs...<end>
segment.target: Yes, $(#sir/ma'am), I'm afraid so. Some were killed by the falling... falling rocks... some killed by the bugs...<end>

segment.source: Yes, $(#sir/ma'am), I'm afraid so. Some were killed by the falling... falling rocks... some killed by the bugs...<end>
Just get us the hell out of here, $(#sir/ma'am)...<end>
segment.target: Just get us the hell out of here, $(#sir/ma'am)...<end>

segment.source: Just get us the hell out of here, $(#sir/ma'am)...<end>
Did you manage to find anything of use in this facility?<end>
segment.target: Did you manage to find anything of use in this facility?<end>

segment.source: Did you manage to find anything of use in this facility?<end>
Nothing... just nothing, $(#sir/ma'am). Only junk...<end>
segment.target: Nothing... just nothing, $(#sir/ma'am). Only junk...<end>

segment.source: Nothing... just nothing, $(#sir/ma'am). Only junk...<end>
It was a waste of resources and lives... this whole operation. A waste.<end>
segment.target: It was a waste of resources and lives... this whole operation. A waste.<end>

segment.source: It was a waste of resources and lives... this whole operation. A waste.<end>
I saw a dead man at the entrance, is he one of yours?<end>
segment.target: I saw a dead man at the entrance, is he one of yours?<end>

segment.source: I saw a dead man at the entrance, is he one of yours?<end>

Yes... he is... We were desperate, $(#sir/ma'am). We had the tools to cut the pipe over there... and it was big enough for a slim man like him to enter. We thought he could get help, or at least reach the lobby... and the Dreadnought there...<end>
segment.target: Yes... he is... We were desperate, $(#sir/ma'am). We had the tools to cut the pipe over there... and it was big enough for a slim man like him to enter. We thought he could get help, or at least reach the lobby... and the Dreadnought there...<end>

segment.source: Yes... he is... We were desperate, $(#sir/ma'am). We had the tools to cut the pipe over there... and it was big enough for a slim man like him to enter. We thought he could get help, or at least reach the lobby... and the Dreadnought there...<end>
Why did you leave your Dreadnought there? You could've used it to kill the burrowers.<end>
segment.target: Why did you leave your Dreadnought there? You could've used it to kill the burrowers.<end>

segment.source: Why did you leave your Dreadnought there? You could've used it to kill the burrowers.<end>

When we... first arrived here... the area was deserted... empty... There were no bugs, no nothing. At least not as big as these. Getting around the narrow hallways is... tricky in that machine. So we left it in a small room near the lobby. It stayed there for a week, we... had no need for it.<end>
segment.target: When we... first arrived here... the area was deserted... empty... There were no bugs, no nothing. At least not as big as these. Getting around the narrow hallways is... tricky in that machine. So we left it in a small room near the lobby. It stayed there for a week, we... had no need for it.<end>

segment.source: When we... first arrived here... the area was deserted... empty... There were no bugs, no nothing. At least not as big as these. Getting around the narrow hallways is... tricky in that machine. So we left it in a small room near the lobby. It stayed there for a week, we... had no need for it.<end>
When this happened... the earthquake and... the bugs, we were cut off from it, $(#sir/ma'am). ::He sighs.::<end>
segment.target: When this happened... the earthquake and... the bugs, we were cut off from it, $(#sir/ma'am). ::He sighs.::<end>

segment.source: When this happened... the earthquake and... the bugs, we were cut off from it, $(#sir/ma'am). ::He sighs.::<end>
Let me ask you something else.<end>
segment.target: Let me ask you something else.<end>

segment.source: Let me ask you something else.<end>
::He nods.::<end>
segment.target: ::He nods.::<end>

segment.source: ::He nods.::<end>
The area has not been secured yet, private. I'll return to you when it has.<end>
segment.target: The area has not been secured yet, private. I'll return to you when it has.<end>

segment.source: The area has not been secured yet, private. I'll return to you when it has.<end>
$(#Sir/Ma'am)... we are too weak to fight. You will have to clear the whole path for us. Please... please hurry.<end>
segment.target: $(#Sir/Ma'am)... we are too weak to fight. You will have to clear the whole path for us. Please... please hurry.<end>

segment.source: $(#Sir/Ma'am)... we are too weak to fight. You will have to clear the whole path for us. Please... please hurry.<end>
I was expecting to find nothing but corpses, but I'm glad you're alive, if barely. I'm Corporal $(context.player.Name).<end>
segment.target: I was expecting to find nothing but corpses, but I'm glad you're alive, if barely. I'm Corporal $(context.player.Name).<end>

segment.source: I was expecting to find nothing but corpses, but I'm glad you're alive, if barely. I'm Corporal $(context.player.Name).<end>

One of the men speaks to you with a weak and dry-sounding voice.::<end>
